description.value: The Bay Leaf is an Indian fusion restaurant in downtown Creston run by chef-owner Dilip Chand, a Nepal-born chef whose culinary career spans India, Bahrain, Ottawa, and Kelowna before he brought his cooking to the East Kootenays. The menu blends Indian, Nepalese, and Hakka dishes with a full-service bar featuring BC and local Creston wines. The restaurant is part of a small regional chain with locations also in Fernie and Cranbrook.
